title: Dog Night, 2005 · after
logline: The morning after six years: the dog asleep on the blanket, and Wood at the drafting table drawing last night's strip with the panels wider than the paper allows, so he tapes a second sheet on. The strip shows the tape.

panels.composition: The garage. WOOD at the table with a strip that runs off the right edge of the sheet. BARNABY asleep.
